geburt.title: Birth of a child
geburt.lead: Register the birth, register the child, tax ID, child benefit (Kindergeld), parental allowance (Elterngeld) and family health insurance — all in one procedure.

voraussetzungen.0: Birth of a child in Germany (the clinic's birth notification is available).
voraussetzungen.1: At least one parent is registered in Germany.
voraussetzungen.2: Confirmed choice of name for the child.

dokumente.0: Clinic birth notification or birth certificate
dokumente.1: Identity card / eID of the parents
dokumente.2: Marriage certificate or acknowledgement of paternity (if applicable)

kindGeburtsdatum.label: Date of birth of the child

pstg.bedeutung: Registration of the birth and issuance of the birth certificate by the registry office (Standesamt).

ao.bedeutung: Application-free issuance of the child's tax identification number.

estg.bedeutung: Entitlement to and determination of child benefit (Kindergeld).

beeg.bedeutung: Entitlement to and determination of parental allowance (Elterngeld) (consent-based income check).

sgbv.bedeutung: Contribution-free family health insurance for the child in the statutory health insurance scheme.

geburt.frist_beschreibung: The birth must be notified to the registry office (Standesamt) within one week (§ 18 PStG).
geburt.gebuehr_hinweis: Fees only apply for additional copies of certificates.
geburt.value_receipt_hinweis: Conservatively estimated: one bundled procedure instead of up to five separate trips to the authorities.

frist_rescue.titel: Parental allowance (Elterngeld) application prepared — your eligibility window
frist_rescue.body: Parental allowance (Elterngeld) should be applied for within the first three months of life; retroactively it is paid for a maximum of three months of life ({norm}). Without an application by {datum}, the first month of life may lapse — an estimated approx. {betrag} € per month (minimum amount; the actual amount depends on your income).

aufenthalt-verlaengerung.title: Extend residence permit (Aufenthaltstitel)
aufenthalt-verlaengerung.lead: Submit the extension application before expiry, receive a provisional certificate (Fiktionsbescheinigung) and reserve the biometrics appointment.

voraussetzungen.0: Existing residence permit (Aufenthaltstitel) that has not yet expired.
voraussetzungen.1: Valid passport and proof of health insurance.
voraussetzungen.2: Application before the permit expires (continued validity under § 81(4) AufenthG).

aufenthg81.bedeutung: Application for extension; a timely application triggers the continued validity (Fortgeltungsfiktion).

pauswg.bedeutung: Citizen-driven, secure identification via eID for the online application.

aufenthv.bedeutung: Setting of the administrative fee for the extension.

azrg.bedeutung: Internal authority cross-check with the Central Register of Foreigners (Ausländerzentralregister) (without any action by you).

aufenthalt-verlaengerung.frist_beschreibung: Submit the application before your permit expires. The demo triggers around 90 days beforehand; it is the timely application — not the appointment — that secures continued validity.
aufenthalt-verlaengerung.gebuehr_hinweis: The application fee of €93 is real; no actual payment takes place in the demo.
aufenthalt-verlaengerung.value_receipt_hinweis: The in-person biometrics appointment remains necessary and is not saved; what is saved are the preparatory trips to the authorities.

kindergeld.title: Child benefit (Kindergeld)
kindergeld.lead: Today a pre-filled application; from 2027 the determination will largely run automatically — you only confirm the bank details.
kindergeld.antragslos_note: Automatic payment is not yet applicable law: the Federal Cabinet (Bundeskabinett) approved the bill on 18.03.2026; the final vote in the Bundestag is scheduled for 09.07.2026. Entry into force is planned in stages for 2027. This demo shows the future procedure: the population register, the Federal Central Tax Office (BZSt) and the family benefits office (Familienkasse) exchange the data; with your eID you only confirm the bank details.

voraussetzungen.0: Child registered in Germany with an allocated tax ID.
voraussetzungen.1: Child benefit entitlement of the parent (§ 62 EStG).

dokumente.0: Birth certificate of the child (from the data chain, no upload needed)

kindGeburtsdatum.label: Date of birth of the child

pstg.bedeutung: Birth registration as the origin of the data chain.

ao.bedeutung: The child's tax ID as the key for automatic determination.

estg.bedeutung: Entitlement to child benefit (Kindergeld); payment from the month of birth, retroactive for max. 6 months.

btdrs.bedeutung: Bill for application-free payment (Cabinet 18.03.2026; final vote in the Bundestag scheduled for 09.07.2026) — not yet in force.

kindergeld.frist_beschreibung: Payment from the month of birth (§ 66 EStG); retroactive for a maximum of six months (§ 70 EStG).
kindergeld.gebuehr_hinweis: No fees are charged for child benefit (Kindergeld).
kindergeld.value_receipt_hinweis: Conservatively estimated: no separate application, only one eID confirmation of the bank details.

reisepass.title: Passport / identity card
reisepass.lead: Prepare the application from your master data and reserve an in-person appointment. The in-person visit remains mandatory.

voraussetzungen.1: In-person visit to record the photo and fingerprints.

dokumente.2: Birth / marriage certificate for first-time applications

fingerabdruecke.label: Fingerprints
fingerabdruecke.hint: I acknowledge that two fingerprints will be taken on site.

passg.bedeutung: Issuance of a passport or identity card.

vorsprache.bedeutung: An in-person visit is mandatory for the entire application.

eu.bedeutung: EU-wide requirements on security features and biometric data.

bmg.bedeutung: Pre-filling of the application data from the population register (Melderegister).

reisepass.frist_beschreibung: No fixed application deadline; plan around 8–12 weeks before your document expires.
reisepass.gebuehr_hinweis: Passport fees depend on age and version; no express option for the identity card.
reisepass.value_receipt_hinweis: The in-person visit remains necessary; what is saved is the preparation and the search for an appointment.

bafoeg.title: BAföG (student aid)
bafoeg.lead: Pre-fill the initial application from your master data and submit it with your eID. Approval is not guaranteed.

voraussetzungen.0: Eligible education at a higher-education institution or school.
voraussetzungen.2: Details on parental income (form 3 + tax assessment).

bafoeg46.bedeutung: Application to the responsible student-aid office (Amt für Ausbildungsförderung).

bafoeg9.bedeutung: Aptitude / study certificate from the institution (form 2).

bafoeg24.bedeutung: Crediting of parental income against the funding.

bafoeg51.bedeutung: In the event of processing delays, an advance payment of 80%.

abgleich.bedeutung: Subsequent data matching for abuse control (no pre-filling).

bafoeg.frist_beschreibung: No cut-off deadline, but funding only starts from the month of application — so submit it in good time before your studies begin.
bafoeg.gebuehr_hinweis: The BAföG procedure is free of charge.
bafoeg.value_receipt_hinweis: Parental income still has to be proven yourself; what is saved is the entry of master data and trips to the authorities.

umzug.title: Moving house
umzug.lead: Register once instead of six visits to the authorities: your change of address is transmitted in a coordinated way to all the relevant offices — you confirm sensitive steps individually via eID.

bmg.bedeutung: Duty to register when you change address: you must register within two weeks of moving in with the residents' registration office (Meldebehörde).

umzug.value_receipt_hinweis: Estimated saving compared with six separate visits to the authorities using paper forms.

ergebnis.lead: Your move is complete — all the relevant authorities have been informed of your new address.
ergebnis.status_sub: Confirmed once — the autopilot handled the rest

pflegegrad.title: Apply for a care level (Pflegegrad)
pflegegrad.lead: Submit the initial application to your care insurance fund (Pflegekasse). The fund commissions the Medical Service (Medizinischer Dienst); the care level (Pflegegrad) is determined only via a home visit.

voraussetzungen.0: Membership of statutory or private long-term care insurance.
voraussetzungen.1: Need for care expected to last (at least 6 months).
voraussetzungen.2: Willingness to be assessed by the Medical Service (home visit).

dokumente.1: Power of attorney / proof of legal guardianship (if available)

sgbxi33.bedeutung: Application for long-term care insurance benefits; the application date = start of benefits.

sgbxi18.bedeutung: The care insurance fund (Pflegekasse) commissions the Medical Service (Medizinischer Dienst) with the assessment.

sgbxi18a.bedeutung: The assessment is generally carried out via a home visit.

sgbxi18c.bedeutung: 25-working-day deadline; in case of delay the fund owes €70 per week.

sgbxi1415.bedeutung: Criteria and modules for determining the care level (Pflegegrad) (1–5).

pflegegrad.frist_beschreibung: The care insurance fund decides within 25 working days (§ 18c SGB XI); otherwise it owes €70 for each week of delay.
pflegegrad.gebuehr_hinweis: The procedure is free of charge for the insured.
pflegegrad.value_receipt_hinweis: The Medical Service home visit remains necessary; what is saved is the application and coordination effort.

ergebnis.lead: Your care-level application was submitted and processed in a coordinated way — in this demo the care-level value is a [MOCK] placeholder.
ergebnis.kennzahl_sub: [MOCK] · determined after the MD home visit (§§ 14, 15 SGB XI)

wohngeld.title: Housing benefit (Wohngeld)
wohngeld.lead: Pre-fill the housing benefit (Wohngeld) application from your master data and submit it with your eID. The official assessment runs in the background.

voraussetzungen.0: Own living space with rent costs (main residence).
voraussetzungen.1: Income within the housing benefit (Wohngeld) limits.
voraussetzungen.2: No current Grundsicherungsgeld benefit (formerly Bürgergeld; exclusion under § 7 WoGG).

dokumente.1: Proof of rent payments for the last three months

bruttokaltmiete.label: Basic rent excluding heating (Bruttokaltmiete)
bruttokaltmiete.hint: as per rental contract, amount in €

wogg22.bedeutung: Housing benefit (Wohngeld) is granted only on application (not application-free).

wogg23.bedeutung: Income determination for the amount of housing benefit (Wohngeld).

wogg33.bedeutung: Authority-initiated data matching for plausibility checks after the application.

wogg7.bedeutung: Exclusion when receiving Grundsicherungsgeld (formerly Bürgergeld) and similar.

wogg2425.bedeutung: Issuance of the decision; approval usually for 12 months.

wohngeld.frist_beschreibung: No cut-off deadline, but payment only from the month of application; approval usually applies for 12 months.
wohngeld.gebuehr_hinweis: The housing benefit (Wohngeld) procedure is free of charge.
wohngeld.value_receipt_hinweis: The exact amount is non-binding [MOCK]; what is saved is the entry of master data and the trip to the housing benefit office (Wohngeldstelle).

kinderzuschlag.title: Child supplement (Kinderzuschlag)
kinderzuschlag.lead: Prepare your child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) application from your master data and submit it with your eID. The Familienkasse (family benefits office) checks income and need after you apply.

voraussetzungen.0: You receive child benefit (Kindergeld) for at least one child in the household.
voraussetzungen.1: Earned income above the minimum income threshold (900 €, single parents 600 €).
voraussetzungen.2: You do not receive basic income support (Grundsicherungsgeld, formerly Bürgergeld).

dokumente.0: Proof of income (pay slips from the last few months)

wohnkosten.label: Gross cold rent (Bruttokaltmiete)
wohnkosten.hint: as per tenancy agreement, amount in €

bkgg6a.bedeutung: Child supplement is granted only on application and depending on income (§ 6a Abs. 7 BKGG).

ozg2.bedeutung: Digital application via the online portal (Online-Zugang).

pauswg18.bedeutung: eID confirmation of your identity upon submission.

kinderzuschlag.frist_beschreibung: No cut-off deadline, but payment only from the month of application.
kinderzuschlag.gebuehr_hinweis: The child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) application is free of charge.
kinderzuschlag.value_receipt_hinweis: The exact amount is non-binding [MOCK] and is only set by the official decision (Bescheid); what is saved is the entry of master data and the trip to the Familienkasse (family benefits office).

disclaimer.prototype:
Prototype notice. This demo shows how a change of address could look in 2027 with the Deutschland-Stack and EUDI Wallet. Data and authority responses are synthetic (marked [MOCK]).

Today (as of May 2026) the registration office (Meldeamt) automatically handles only some of the steps shown: the move-out notification to the previous registration authority (§ 33 BMG), the address update on the national ID card (§ 28 PAuswG), and the regular transmissions to the tax office (Finanzamt), the broadcasting fee service (Beitragsservice) and the military administration (Wehrverwaltung) (§ 36 BMG together with § 11 (4) RBStV / § 39 AO / § 58c SG). Health insurance, banks, insurers, employers and energy providers require the consent of the person concerned (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR). Vehicle owners, the family benefits office (Familienkasse) and the immigration authority (Ausländerbehörde) each need a separate active notification — this demo simulates eID-confirmed fast-track processing that is not yet available in production nationwide.
disclaimer.bussgeld_frist_modal: § 17 BMG requires you to register within two weeks of moving in. § 54 (2) no. 1 BMG sets a fine framework of up to 1,000 € for this. In municipal practice, citizens' offices (Bürgerämter) typically impose 10–50 € for late registration; the exact amount is decided by the office on a case-by-case basis. Fines of up to 50,000 € under § 54 (1) BMG apply only to false statements or non-disclosure, not to late filings.

disclaimer.opening:
Notice on opening. This app is a reading and explanation layer for letters from public authorities. Opening or marking-as-read a letter card here is **only an in-app reading status** — it is **not** a retrieval within the meaning of § 41 (2a) VwVfG or § 122a AO and triggers **no** legal notification (rechtliche Bekanntgabe).

Legal notification depends on the delivery channel of the **official** authority:
- **Postal mail (Briefpost)** (most common case — health insurance, broadcasting fee service / Beitragsservice, family benefits office / Familienkasse, immigration authority / Ausländerbehörde, citizens' office / Bürgeramt, fines authority / Bußgeldstelle): deemed served on the **fourth day after being posted** (§ 41 (2) VwVfG or § 122 (2) AO since the post-law modernisation act of 01.01.2025).
- **Mein ELSTER** (tax assessments where the tax return was filed electronically): deemed served on the **fourth day after being made available for retrieval** (§ 122a (4) AO). From 01.01.2027 electronic notification will be the default (opt-out); until then a transitional phase with active opt-in applies.
- **Central citizen mailbox (ZBP/BundID) with consent**: deemed served on the **day after retrieval** (§ 41 (2a) VwVfG). If not retrieved within 10 days, no notification takes place.
- **Formal electronic delivery** (e.g. administrative procedures, social court): deemed delivered on the **fourth day after dispatch**, rebuttable on proof of later access (§ 5 (7) VwZG).

Please check your **official mailboxes** and your physical letterbox **regularly**. This app does not replace that.

disclaimer.no_legal_advice:
This AI explanation is **general information** and a reading aid — **not a legal service** within the meaning of the German Legal Services Act (§ 2 RDG). It does **not** assess your individual case (BGH I ZR 113/20 ‚Smartlaw' line: tool character, no client relationship, no promise of success).

A concrete legal assessment — for example whether an objection has prospects of success, which reasoning would be persuasive, or whether a notice (Bescheid) is lawful — can **only** be given by a person authorised to provide legal services: a lawyer (Rechtsanwält:in, BRAO), a consumer-advice centre (Verbraucherzentrale, UKlaG/§ 8 RDG), a social welfare association (e.g. SoVD, VdK), or the competent chamber of tax advisers. The AI gives **no guarantees of success** and does **not** represent you before public authorities. Suggested replies or deadlines are non-binding; responsibility for every entry and every dispatch is yours.

einspruch_ao.title: File the objection with the right authority
einspruch_ao.body: An objection (Einspruch) must be lodged with the authority whose administrative act is being challenged (§ 357 (2) sentence 1 of the Fiscal Code, Abgabenordnung, AO). We have taken „{empfaenger_behoerde}“ from the letterhead as the addressee. Please verify the recipient address yourself — an objection lodged with the wrong body only preserves the deadline if it reaches the competent authority while the deadline is still running (§ 357 (2) sentence 4 AO).

pre_insertion_modal.einspruch_ao_familienkasse_zusatz: Note: Kindergeld (child benefit) decisions are challenged under the rules of the Fiscal Code (Abgabenordnung, AO) — not under the Social Court Act (Sozialgerichtsgesetz). Deadline and form follow from § 357 AO. This is because Kindergeld is a tax benefit within the meaning of § 31 of the Income Tax Act (Einkommensteuergesetz, EStG) (BFH III R 26/22, 2023).

widerspruch_sgg.title: File the formal protest with the right authority
widerspruch_sgg.body: A Widerspruch in a social-insurance matter must be lodged with the body that issued the notice (§ 84 (2) sentence 1 of the Social Court Act, Sozialgerichtsgesetz, SGG). We have taken „{empfaenger_behoerde}“ from the letterhead as the addressee. Please verify the recipient address yourself — lodging with another domestic authority preserves the deadline only because that authority must forward the protest to the competent body without delay (§ 84 (2) sentence 2 SGG).

widerspruch_vwgo.title: File the formal protest with the right authority
widerspruch_vwgo.body: A Widerspruch must be lodged with the authority that issued the contested administrative act (§ 70 (1) sentence 1 of the Code of Administrative Court Procedure, Verwaltungsgerichtsordnung, VwGO). We have taken „{empfaenger_behoerde}“ from the letterhead as the addressee. Please verify the recipient address yourself — in some federal states (such as Bavaria) the formal-protest procedure has been abolished for certain subject areas; in those cases an action must be brought directly before the administrative court (Verwaltungsgericht) instead of a Widerspruch.

aussetzung_ao.title: Suspension of enforcement — important notes
aussetzung_ao.body: Suspension of enforcement (Aussetzung der Vollziehung) must be applied for at the tax authority that issued the contested notice (§ 361 (2) sentence 1 of the Fiscal Code, Abgabenordnung, AO). It is **not granted automatically** — the authority will only grant suspension if there are serious doubts as to the lawfulness of the notice or if enforcement would constitute undue hardship (§ 361 (2) sentence 2 AO). Late-payment penalties under § 240 AO continue to accrue as long as suspension has not been granted; furthermore, suspension presupposes that an objection (Einspruch) has already been filed.

frist_cited_format.einspruch_ao: You have **1 month** from notification of the notice to file an objection — **§ 355 (1) of the Fiscal Code (Abgabenordnung, AO)**. The deadline ends on {frist_datum}.
frist_cited_format.widerspruch_sgg: You have **1 month** from notification of the notice to file a formal protest — **§ 84 (1) of the Social Court Act (Sozialgerichtsgesetz, SGG)**. The deadline ends on {frist_datum}.
frist_cited_format.widerspruch_vwgo: You have **1 month** from notification of the notice to file a formal protest — **§ 70 (1) sentence 1 of the Code of Administrative Court Procedure (Verwaltungsgerichtsordnung, VwGO)**. The deadline ends on {frist_datum}.
frist_cited_format.aussetzung_ao: You can apply for a suspension of enforcement at any time while the objection proceedings are pending — **§ 361 (2) of the Fiscal Code (Abgabenordnung, AO)**. There is no separate deadline, but filing quickly is important because late-payment penalties under § 240 AO continue to accrue.

disclaimer.lese_schicht: This app is a **read-only signposting layer**. It does **not** make any changes to your data in the responsible registers itself. Corrections are made exclusively through the relevant authority's procedure — for example, at the citizens' office (Bürgeramt) under § 17 BMG for your address; at the registry office (Standesamt) under PStG for marital status and given names; at the registry office (Standesamt) under § 4 SBGG for the **registration** of a gender-entry change (orally or in writing, three months before the declaration) and under § 2 SBGG for the **in-person notarisation of the declaration** at the registry office; at the Federal Central Tax Office (Bundeszentralamt für Steuern) for the tax identification number (§ 139b AO). For each field we show you the right path.
disclaimer.audit_log_app_internal: The activity log shown here records only your activities within this app (views, filters, self-edits). It is **not** an official authority audit trail. The official audit layer for IDNr-based data transmissions between public bodies is provided by the Privacy Cockpit (Datenschutzcockpit) under § 9 IDNrG with a 24-month retention period — available at datenschutzcockpit.bund.de once the relevant registers are connected. As of May 2026: pilot phase with limited register coverage; the Federal Motor Transport Authority (Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt) joined the IDA procedure on 15 April 2026, with DSC connection to follow. A nationwide connection of all 51 RegMoG registers is on the 2026/2027 roadmap.
disclaimer.eudi_speculative: The function shown here — releasing personal data as a wallet credential (attestation) to private recipients (e.g. bank, landlord, energy provider) at the click of a button — simulates a **vision for 2027**. It is based on the EUDI Wallet Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 and the Architecture and Reference Framework (as of May 2026: v2.9.0). The duty to provide an EUDI Wallet applies in Germany no earlier than 2026/2027; third-party acceptance, trust-service compliance and fee models are not yet finalised in law.
disclaimer.iban_speculative: A central IBAN record with automatic transfer to the family benefits office (Familienkasse), tax office (Finanzamt) and health insurer (Krankenkasse) is **not** available today (May 2026). This demo simulates a 2027 pattern. At present you must file your bank details with each authority separately.
disclaimer.religion_art9: Religious affiliation is a special category of personal data under Art. 9 GDPR. It is shown here only on click. Storage in the registration register is based on § 3 (1) no. 11 BMG; its use for income tax and church tax is based on § 51a EStG together with the church-tax procedure at the Federal Central Tax Office (KiStAM at BZSt).

The duty to register under § 17 Abs. 1 BMG (two weeks from move-in, subject to a fine under § 54 BMG) and the responsibility of the registration office (Meldebehörde) at the new place of residence apply in reality. For residence permits, the legally decisive step is filing the application before expiry (continued-validity fiction, Fortgeltungsfiktion § 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG; provisional certificate, Fiktionsbescheinigung § 81 Abs. 5 AufenthG) — the in-person appointment is issued by the immigration office (Ausländerbehörde), often by invitation; this demo does not book an appointment there. Calendar access reads availability only (free/busy), no appointment contents (data minimisation, Art. 5 Abs. 1 lit. c, Art. 25 DSGVO).
